text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ...I won, against Creek...!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I... actually won.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Thank you.
My heart is burning so brightly...!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Oguri-chan...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Ngh! Creek...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
...Congratulations.
You were very... very strong.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Still...
I can't let it end here either.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Next time we meet 'here', Oguri-chan...
I'll be taking the win, okay?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...I won't lose either.
I'll beat you next time too.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Fufu... Look forward to it, okay?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...Creek won't let things end like this either.
I must build up even more strength.

"With little time spent reveling in the joy of victory,
Oguri Cap is already looking ahead.
And then—"

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Trainer.
I... want to become even stronger!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
That's why I want to run in lots of races.
I'm sure it's what I need right now.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Creek will surely enter next year's Arima Kinen.
And there, she intends to defeat me.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"Then there is no way I can sit this out.
...Nor can I afford to lose."

Oguri Cap currently has plenty of ability.
In that case, what she needs next might be gaining
experience in GⅠ races.

Polishing her skills in GⅠ races packed with formidable rivals.
The experience cultivated there will surely
help her grow even further.
choice_data_list: Alright, let's enter lots of races!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Yeah!

Oguri Cap is fully fired up!
Just as the two of us were about to discuss our strategy for the next race—

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Coming in!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Ah, Tama...!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I watched ya closely right from the start~
Good work out there!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Man, to think you'd beat Creek!
You really are something else!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Thank you, Tama—

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Whoops...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Wait, are you okay?!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Ah, no, I'm fine.
I just felt a bit weak for a moment...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps it was seeing Tama's face.
I felt a little relieved.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
...
What's up with that?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ...Tama?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Hey, am I yer mother or somethin'?
'Cause I ain't, right?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"I'm an Umamusume too, ya know!
Did ya forget that or somethin'!?"

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Huh... N-No, I haven't forgotten.
After all, Tama, you're definitely an Umamusume, right?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Aaargh, don't just take it literally!
What I'm tryin' to say is!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: —That means I'm your rival too!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"...I've decided, right here and now!
I'm gonna fight ya!"

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
...To tell the truth, I was plannin' to challenge
the Dream Trophy startin' next year, but.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Huh...

—The "Dream Trophy League."
A higher-level league where Umamusume who made their mark in the Twinkle Series compete.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Seeing you race Creek made up my mind.
I'm staying one more year to beat you!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Let's settle who's on top.
Me, Creek, or you!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Listen up, Oguri.
—Your next opponent is gonna be me!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...It's fine.
Now, let's make our next plan.

Although the battle with Super Creek was over,
yet another formidable rival appeared before Oguri Cap.

Oguri Cap looked somewhat downcast.
And thus, a period of trials began for her...!
